Additionally, our team supports the Human-Systems Integration (HSI) Division, which enables the development of complex aerospace systems through analysis and modeling of human performance and human-automation interactions. HSI’s research includes work in human performance, integration and evaluation, and human-computer interaction. Much of the research performed in HSI is collaborative, team-based activities that rely upon an advanced, distributed human-in-the-loop simulation environment and state-of-the-art facilities to investigate the roles, responsibilities, and requirements for human operators and automation in complex systems. Research participants include industry partners, professional air traffic service providers, pilots, and aviation operators who help to develop and test novel aviation concepts, technologies, or procedures for designing and testing new air traffic operations in the global and United States National Airspace System. At least five years of experience supporting NASA aeronautics research laboratories, human systems laboratories, or comparable technical research environments. At least five years of experience administering, maintaining, or overseeing laboratory computer systems, infrastructure, and associated equipment. Ability to work on-site at NASA Ames Research Center in Mountain View, California. This is an on-site position. Demonstrated knowledge of laboratory system architecture, system interactions, hardware and software integration, and operational requirements. Experience installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting Windows-based systems and associated hardware and software. Ability to collaborate effectively with researchers, software developers, engineers, students, and other technical personnel in a multidisciplinary environment. Strong technical documentation, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.
